title: Jim Penniston told the beings come from 8,000 years in the future (Rendlesham)

tellings.quote: specifically told Jim penniston they said we are you uh we come from 8,000 years in the future and yeah that they're having problems with reproduction and they're taking these gtes

plain: In 1980, in Rendlesham Forest in England, beings are said to have told a witness named Jim Penniston, "we are you, we come from 8,000 years in the future," and that they were having problems reproducing and were taking things from people because of it. A researcher named Mike Masters repeats this, without naming his source, as support for his idea that the visitors are humans from the future. If true, the so-called aliens would be our own distant descendants.
